# TUTORERA Platform Description

TUTORERA is Pakistan's student-led digital tutoring marketplace operated by MENTISERA (SMC-Private) Limited. The platform connects students and parents with verified tutors for online and in-person educational support across Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, UAE, and other markets.

## Core Purpose
TUTORERA enables students to post tuition requirements and receive transparent offers from qualified tutors. The platform uses an 8-layer smart matching engine with Bayesian ratings to recommend compatible tutors. All tutor verifications—including CNIC, education credentials, demo video, and police clearance—are tracked per-component with canonical status computation.

## Key Features
- Student-led tuition request posting with budget and schedule preferences
- Verified tutor directory with match scoring, availability, and structured profiles
- Structured negotiation with max 3 counter-offers per party
- Secure payment flow with atomic booking creation and webhook confirmation
- Per-component tutor verification (identity, education, demo video, police)
- Admin control tower with at-risk request rescue, supply-gap intelligence, and financial reconciliation
- 11-role RBAC with granular permissions
- Email webhook tracking and delivery monitoring
- Request expiry lifecycle with archival and retention
- Multi-country market configuration (PK, SA, AE, GB)
